name: Created
importNotes: Imported from the Created Training Center Equipment sheet. Only the Lower Extremity tab has an ID Number column.
Floor IDs on that sheet are L1, L2, and L3. Every other row is stored under a placeholder key UNASSIGNED-<section>-<row> with idMissing true. Placeholder keys are not for placards.
The L1 guide is the printed Machine Guide placard for the Nautilus 2ST Hip Extension (Super Glute Machine). Sheet columns stay on the record; placard sentences live under guide.
Business Equipment type and method cells repeat the Restorative Equipment rows and look pasted into the wrong columns. The exported text is unchanged.
Name-only rows, and the three identical Nautilus Dumbbell Rack lines, are kept as separate entries.

guide.title: HIP EXTENSION MACHINE
guide.setup: Pad at 11 o'clock. Hips at red dot. Belt on.
guide.movement: Drive legs straight. Pause. Slow return.
guide.caution: Control it. Challenge yourself. Smooth reps, no momentum.
